same_law.key_value: 3% for July 1, 2025 – June 30, 2026 (LAHD allowable rent increase percentage), once every 12 months; no added utility percentage after 2026-02-02
same_law.reason: Both cards state the Los Angeles RSO annual allowable rent increase (LAMC Chapter XV): an increase once every 12 months up to the LAHD percentage, and no utility add-on after February 2, 2026. r-0087 gives the current figure of 3%.

coverage_only.reason: This card states no rent limit. It only describes which units the RSO covers (certificate of occupancy before October 1, 1978), which is the coverage of the RSO allowable-increase rule.
